name: @irondsd/inline-svg
description: InlineSVG is a TypeScript library that allows you to easily inline SVG files into your HTML or JavaScript code. It provides a simple API to load SVG files and insert them directly into the DOM, making it easier to manage and manipulate SVG graphics in web applications.

scripts.publish:patch: npm version patch && npm publish --access public
scripts.publish:minor: npm version minor && npm publish --access public
scripts.publish:major: npm version major && npm publish --access public

author: irondsd
